description: This file contains functions for generating JSON representations of PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) transmission and reception metrics, including latency, throughput, and CPU usage, for use in network performance monitoring.

methods.name: generate_pdcp_tx
methods.description: Generates a JSON object with PDCP transmission metrics such as latency, throughput, and CPU usage.

methods.name: generate_pdcp_rx
methods.description: Generates a JSON object with PDCP reception metrics such as latency, throughput, and CPU usage.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a JSON object combining TX and RX metrics with a timestamp.

methods.name: generate_string
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON string of the combined metrics with specified indentation.
